_about: Kezza Clinic pSEO registry: the source of truth for categories, treatments, URLs, search intent, clinic availability and internal links. Clinic facts (addresses, phones, doctors) stay in site-data.json. Treatment page CONTENT lives in tools/content/pages/*.html; a generated page's publishing status and reviewer are set in that file. type: static = hand-built page, generated = built by tools/content/build_content_pages.py, section = content that exists only as a section of a hub page (no page of its own). Run npm run build after editing, then npm test.
